description: Draft the follow-up email after a sales call from the seller's notes — what the seller heard, in the buyer's words, what was agreed, and the next step with a date — promising nothing the notes and policy do not support. Use when a seller has just finished a call and needs to send a recap. Not for a cold first email to a new prospect; see /marketing-cold-email.
